specs.title: unfinished today renders a real canvas tooltip with no comparison series
every theme control and live chart follow same-page and cross-tab changes
denied browser storage does not break startup, toggling or URL-selected dark theme
only login/setup use the split artwork; real share and invitation flows remain single column
